title: Why Anthropic Replaced Git to Handle 30,000 Daily AI Pull Requests
description: When Anthropic scaled their autonomous coding agents from 2,500 to 30,000 PRs per day, traditional Git choked under network spikes and storage limits. Discover the 7-engineer custom distributed storage system that replaced it.

promptSet.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent PR Reviewer
promptSet.prompt: Act as an autonomous Git reviewer agent. Parse the following git diff, identify breaking changes, test coverage deficits, and security vulnerabilities. Format the response as a GitHub PR review markdown with clear pass/fail status.
instructions: Provide your Git diff or pull request changes.
Run the prompt through Claude Code or your agent terminal.
Review automated line-by-line recommendations and test coverage gaps.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Markdown formatted PR review identifying 2 potential null pointer exceptions with proposed patch code.
